family: Spectral typed request and descriptor contracts
status: 58 CPU fixtures authored, uncompiled and unrun
cases: All three existing fit input routes with retained-state flag off/on.
All three embedding routes with both Laplacian normalization and drop-first flags off/on; distinct Lanczos/output widths.
Both affinity modes for direct query, resident preparation and resident query.
Every fixed operation, exact integer result/handle9007199254740993, seed4294967295 and binary64 tolerance0.10000000000000002.
Every operation propagates the exact native error; malformed request reports once without publishing a result.
Missing result, unknown operation, metadata arguments, fit span counts, missing embedding/query/resident/release spans and preparation scalar count.
Named provider table retains one callable fixed entry.
oracle: Prescribed raw wire fields are checked independently of the product dispatcher, then dispatcher decoding is checked by a typed mock provider. No numerical formula, algorithm, provider implementation or public admission is emulated.
parallel_plan: All58 independent fixtures use host_parallelize, with private inline request/result/error storage; no GPU work or shared mutable fixture state.
limits: Fake data addresses are compared only and never reach numerical kernels.
This does not test fitted state ownership, public parameter admission, provider capabilities or numerical backends; those concrete APIs remain pending.
No native compile/runtime, installed boundary, cross-vendor identity or performance claim.
